zodiacs.name: 鼠
zodiacs.traits: 机智、适应性强、魅力十足
zodiacs.description: 属鼠的人通常很聪明，善于抓住机会，具有很强的适应能力。
zodiacs.description_en: People born in the Year of the Rat are usually intelligent, good at seizing opportunities, and highly adaptable.

zodiacs.name: 牛
zodiacs.description: 属牛的人踏实稳重，做事认真负责，是值得信赖的伙伴。
zodiacs.description_en: People born in the Year of the Ox are down-to-earth, serious and responsible, and trustworthy partners.

zodiacs.name: 虎
zodiacs.description: 属虎的人充满勇气，天生具有领导才能，敢于挑战困难。
zodiacs.description_en: People born in the Year of the Tiger are full of courage, natural leaders, and dare to face challenges.

zodiacs.name: 兔
zodiacs.description: 属兔的人性格温和，处事谨慎，具有优雅的气质和艺术天分。
zodiacs.description_en: People born in the Year of the Rabbit are gentle, cautious, with elegant temperament and artistic talent.

zodiacs.name: 龙
zodiacs.description: 属龙的人雄心勃勃，富有创造力，天生具有领袖气质。
zodiacs.description_en: People born in the Year of the Dragon are ambitious, creative, and born with leadership qualities.

zodiacs.name: 蛇
zodiacs.description: 属蛇的人智慧深邃，具有敏锐的直觉和神秘的魅力。
zodiacs.description_en: People born in the Year of the Snake are deeply wise, with keen intuition and mysterious charm.

zodiacs.name: 马
zodiacs.description: 属马的人热爱自由，精力充沛，喜欢探索新事物。
zodiacs.description_en: People born in the Year of the Horse love freedom, are energetic, and enjoy exploring new things.

zodiacs.name: 羊
zodiacs.description: 属羊的人性格温柔，富有同情心，具有很强的艺术天赋。
zodiacs.description_en: People born in the Year of the Goat are gentle, compassionate, and have strong artistic talents.

zodiacs.name: 猴
zodiacs.description: 属猴的人机智幽默，好奇心强，善于学习新事物。
zodiacs.description_en: People born in the Year of the Monkey are witty, humorous, curious, and good at learning new things.

zodiacs.name: 鸡
zodiacs.description: 属鸡的人诚实可靠，勤奋努力，时间观念很强。
zodiacs.description_en: People born in the Year of the Rooster are honest, reliable, hardworking, and have a strong sense of time.

zodiacs.name: 狗
zodiacs.description: 属狗的人忠诚可靠，诚实正直，具有强烈的责任感。
zodiacs.description_en: People born in the Year of the Dog are loyal, reliable, honest, and have a strong sense of responsibility.

zodiacs.name: 猪
zodiacs.description: 属猪的人心地善良，慷慨大方，总是保持乐观的态度。
zodiacs.description_en: People born in the Year of the Pig are kind-hearted, generous, and always maintain an optimistic attitude.
